label: May 1996
detail: First anti-speculation package: bank LTV cap 80%; SSD on sales within 3 years; deemed income tax on gains within 3 years; no SGD housing loans for non-PR foreigners and foreign companies; BSD payable at option exercise

label: Sep 1997
detail: HDB owners subject to 5-year minimum occupation before buying private property

label: Nov 1997
detail: SSD suspended to improve market liquidity during Asian Financial Crisis

label: Jun 1998
detail: BSD payment deferred to TOP/completion for uncompleted properties

label: Oct 2001
detail: Deemed income tax on 3-year gains removed; non-PR foreigners and foreign companies allowed SGD housing loans (post dot-com and 9/11 support)

label: Jul 2005
detail: Bank LTV raised 80% to 90%; minimum cash down payment cut 10% to 5% (HDB bank-loan buyers aligned at 5%)

label: Oct 2007
detail: Deferred Payment Scheme for uncompleted private homes abolished

label: Sep 2009
detail: Interest Absorption Scheme and interest-only housing loans disallowed

label: Feb 2010
detail: SSD re-introduced for sales within 1 year; bank LTV cut 90% to 80%

label: Aug 2010
detail: SSD holding period 1 to 3 years; LTV for buyers with existing loan 80% to 70%; minimum cash 5% to 10% for them

label: Jan 2011
detail: SSD 4 years at 16/12/8/4%; LTV 60% for individuals with existing loan; 50% for non-individuals

label: Dec 2011
detail: ABSD introduced: foreigners and entities 10%; PR 2nd+ 3%; SC 3rd+ 3%

label: Oct 2012
detail: Loan tenure capped at 35 years; tighter LTV for tenure >30 years or beyond age 65

label: Jan 2013
detail: ABSD raised (SC 2nd 7% / 3rd 10%; PR 1st 5% / 2nd+ 10%; foreigners and entities 15%); tighter LTV for 2nd+ loans; min cash 25% for 2nd+ loans; MSR 30% for FI loans on HDB/EC

label: Jun 2013
detail: Total Debt Servicing Ratio framework introduced at 60%

label: Aug 2013
detail: HDB loan tenure 30 to 25 years; HDB MSR 35% to 30%; PR households must wait 3 years before buying resale HDB

label: Dec 2013
detail: 30% MSR for EC bought from developers; resale levy for second-timer EC buyers

label: Mar 2017
detail: SSD cut to 3 years at 12/8/4%; TDSR disapplied to mortgage equity withdrawal loans at LTV <=50%

label: Feb 2018
detail: Top marginal BSD rate 4% on portion above $1m (Budget 2018)

label: Jul 2018
detail: ABSD +5pp individuals / +10pp entities (SC 2nd 12% / 3rd 15%; foreigners 20%; entities 25%); bank LTV cut 5pp (1st loan 75%)

label: Sep 2019
detail: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG) introduced for first-timer buyers (up to $80,000); HDB income ceilings raised to $14,000 for families and $7,000 for singles

label: Dec 2021
detail: ABSD raised (SC 2nd 17% / 3rd 25%; PR 2nd 25% / 3rd 30%; foreigners 30%; entities 35%); TDSR 60% to 55%; HDB loan LTV 90% to 85%

label: May 2022
detail: Residential property transferred into a living trust charged ABSD at the entity rate (ABSD Trust)

label: Sep 2022
detail: TDSR/MSR interest floor +0.5pp; 3% floor for HDB loans; HDB LTV 85% to 80%; 15-month wait-out for private owners buying non-subsidised HDB resale

label: Feb 2023
detail: BSD 5% on portion $1.5m-$3m and 6% above $3m (Budget 2023)

label: Feb 2023
detail: CPF Housing Grant for first-timer resale buyers increased (Budget 2023)

label: Apr 2023
detail: ABSD raised (SC 2nd 20% / 3rd 30%; PR 2nd 30% / 3rd 35%; foreigners 60%; entities 65%)

label: Aug 2024
detail: HDB loan LTV 80% to 75%; Enhanced CPF Housing Grant raised to up to $120,000 for first-timer families and $60,000 for singles

label: Jul 2025
detail: SSD holding period 3 to 4 years; rates +4pp (16/12/8/4%) for purchases from 4 Jul 2025

label: Jul 2026
detail: 15-month wait-out for private owners buying non-subsidised HDB resale removed (after RPI fell in 1Q and 2Q 2026)

label: Jul 1997
detail: Asian Financial Crisis: Thai baht floated 2 Jul 1997; regional currency and property collapse

label: Mar 2000
detail: Dot-com bust: NASDAQ peak 10 Mar 2000 to market trough Oct 2002

label: Sep 2001
detail: September 11 attacks: Terror attacks in US; global risk-off

label: Mar 2003
detail: SARS outbreak in Singapore: Local outbreak Mar 2003; Singapore declared SARS-free 31 May 2003

label: Aug 2007
detail: Subprime crisis onset: Credit markets freeze from 9 Aug 2007

label: Sep 2008
detail: Global Financial Crisis: Lehman Brothers collapse 15 Sep 2008; recession to mid-2009

label: May 2010
detail: European sovereign debt crisis: First Greek bailout May 2010 to ECB whatever-it-takes Jul 2012

label: Aug 2011
detail: US credit rating downgrade: S&P downgrades US; equity sell-off

label: May 2013
detail: Taper tantrum: Fed signals QE tapering; Asian rates and currencies hit

label: Aug 2015
detail: China devaluation and market rout: Yuan devaluation 11 Aug 2015; oil collapse; global sell-off

label: Jun 2016
detail: Brexit referendum: UK votes to leave EU

label: Jul 2018
detail: US-China trade war: First US tariffs on Chinese goods 6 Jul 2018

label: Jan 2020
detail: COVID-19 pandemic: First Singapore case 23 Jan 2020; WHO pandemic 11 Mar 2020

label: Apr 2020
detail: Singapore Circuit Breaker: Lockdown; property viewings and HDB transactions disrupted

label: Feb 2022
detail: Russia-Ukraine war and energy shock: Invasion 24 Feb 2022; commodity and inflation spike

label: Mar 2022
detail: Fed tightening cycle: Fed hikes from 16 Mar 2022 to last hike 26 Jul 2023; SORA and mortgage rates surge

label: Mar 2023
detail: US regional banking stress: SVB collapse 10 Mar 2023

label: Sep 2024
detail: Fed easing cycle: First Fed cut 18 Sep 2024; mortgage rates fall

label: Apr 2025
detail: US reciprocal tariff shock: US tariffs announced 2 Apr 2025; global equity sell-off
